{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Drop duplicate patient_id entries, keeping the highest sample_seq
trial_df = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False).drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Check for missing values
print(trial_df.isnull().sum())

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print("Sentinel value in biomarker_baseline:", trial_df['biomarker_baseline'].isin([-999.0]).any())

# Check the distribution of severity by sex
print("\nSeverity distribution by sex:\")
print(trial_df.groupby(['sex', 'severity']).size().unstack(fill_value=0))

# Check the distribution of arm by sex and severity
print("\nArm distribution by sex and severity:")
print(trial_df.groupby(['sex', 'arm', 'severity']).size().unstack(fill_value=0))"}
